faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about {{APP_NAME}}

items.question: What is {{APP_NAME}}?
items.answer: {{APP_NAME}} is a multi-model AI chat platform that gives you access to 15+ premium AI models from one interface. We provide conversation management, usage analytics, and transparent credit-based pricing to help you optimize your AI workflow.

items.question: How does the credit system work?
items.answer: All subscription plans include AI credits in USD that cover actual AI model costs from OpenRouter. Credits are automatically tracked and deducted based on your usage. You can monitor your credit balance and usage in real-time from your dashboard.

items.question: Which AI models are supported?
items.answer: We support 15+ premium AI models including Claude (multiple versions), GPT-4, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek, and more through OpenRouter. All models are available to paid subscribers, with costs deducted from your monthly credit allocation.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial?
items.answer: Yes! All subscription plans include a free trial period. Monthly plans get 7 days trial, and yearly plans get 14 days trial. During your trial, you receive $1 in credits to test the platform. You can upgrade anytime to unlock your full plan credits.

items.question: How secure is my data?
items.answer: All conversations are encrypted in transit and at rest using industry-standard encryption. We never share your data with third parties. You maintain full control over your conversation history and can delete your data anytime through your account settings.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Absolutely! You can cancel your subscription at any time with no questions asked through the customer portal. You'll retain access until the end of your current billing period, and no further charges will be made.
